cards.card_text: When the altar is anointed, the leaders bring offerings for its dedication and present them before the altar.
cards.verse_text: When the altar was anointed, the leaders approached with their offerings for its dedication and presented them before the altar.
cards.snippet: …the altar was anointed, the leaders approached with their offerings for its dedication and presented them before the altar.

cards.card_text: The LORD tells Moses that each ___, one leader is to present his offering for the dedication.
cards.verse_text: And the LORD said to Moses, “Each day one leader is to present his offering for the dedication of the altar.”
cards.snippet: …Moses, “Each day one leader is to present his offering for the dedication of the altar.”

cards.card_text: On the eighth day they hold a solemn assembly, since the altar's dedication took seven days and the feast seven more.
cards.verse_text: On the eighth day they held a solemn assembly, for the dedication of the altar had lasted seven days, and the feast seven days more.
cards.snippet: On the eighth day they held a solemn assembly, for the dedication of the altar had lasted seven days, and the feast seven days…

cards.card_text: The priests, the Levites and the rest of the exiles celebrate the dedication of the house of God with joy.
cards.verse_text: Then the people of Israel—the priests, the Levites, and the rest of the exiles—celebrated the dedication of the house of God with joy.
cards.snippet: …of Israel—the priests, the Levites, and the rest of the exiles—celebrated the dedication of the house of God with joy.

cards.card_text: For the dedication of the house of God, the people of Israel offer a hundred bulls, two hundred rams and four hundred lambs, plus a sin offering for all Israel of twelve male goats.
cards.verse_text: For the dedication of the house of God they offered a hundred bulls, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs, and a sin offering for all Israel of twelve male goats, one for each tribe of Israel.
cards.snippet: For the dedication of the house of God they offered a hundred bulls, two hundred…

cards.card_text: The Levites have arrived in Jerusalem for the dedication of the wall.
cards.verse_text: At the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem, the Levites were sought out from all their homes and brought to Jerusalem to celebrate the joyous dedication with thanksgiving and singing, accompanied by cymbals, harps, and lyres.
cards.snippet: At the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem, the Levites were sought out from all…

cards.card_text: This is a psalm of David, king of Israel, a song for the dedication of the temple.
cards.verse_text: A song for the dedication of the temple.
cards.snippet: A song for the dedication of the temple.

cards.card_text: To attend the statue's dedication To pay the king's new taxes To choose a new governor
cards.verse_text: Then King Nebuchadnezzar sent word to assemble the satraps, prefects, governors, advisers, treasurers, judges, magistrates, and all the other officials of the provinces to attend the dedication of the statue he had set up.
cards.snippet: …magistrates, and all the other officials of the provinces to attend the dedication of the statue he had set up.

cards.card_text: Now it's winter in Jerusalem, the Feast of Dedication is going on, and Jesus is walking in the temple courts, in Solomon’s Colonnade.
cards.verse_text: At that time the Feast of Dedication took place in Jerusalem.
cards.snippet: At that time the Feast of Dedication took place in Jerusalem.
